content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Koraput District Court Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://koraput.dcourts.gov.in/notice-category/recruitments/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Koraput District Court Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications is 10th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist position in the Koraput District Court recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a +3 Examination or equivalent from a recognized University and possess a Diploma in Computer Application from a recognized institute. An Odia language test equivalent to M.E. Standard is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the Pay Matrix Level-4, ranging from Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What are the stages involved in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, a Computer Science Test (Practical), and a Viva-Voce Test.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Junior Clerk-cum-Copyist post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Koraput District Court, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify the minimum and maximum age limits. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any age-related information.

faq.question: Q10. In which city is this Koraput District Court located?
faq.answer: The Koraput District Court is located in Jeypore, Odisha.
